# Mobile UI Refinement Skill

## When to use
- Improve clarity for young users
- Increase tap comfort and layout readability
- Rework status visibility and labels
- Polish visual hierarchy without changing product scope

## Procedure
1. Score current UI with [heuristics](./references/heuristics.md).
2. Propose up to 5 high-impact UI changes.
3. Apply minimal style/markup updates.
4. Re-check tap target size and text clarity.
5. Summarize before/after impact.
